sources.entry: HoopsAI - Offers real-time trading insights and analysis for retail investors. #free

summary.name: HoopsAI
summary.one_liner: HoopsAI is an AI-powered investing platform that offers real-time market insights and trading analysis for retail investors, listed as free.
use_cases: Tracking real-time market news and economic data releases
Connecting a investment portfolio to view holdings
Getting AI-driven trading and investment insights
Following Fed and inflation news that affects markets
summary.what_it_does: The page presents itself as an AI-powered platform for investment decisions and real-time market insights. Visible features include a login prompt to connect a portfolio, a login prompt to view a watchlist, and a "How can I help you?" assistant prompt. The main content is a scrolling feed of dated financial news headlines (Fed policy, GDP, inflation, individual stocks) and an upcoming-events countdown list. The page text does not describe the AI methods or specific analysis features in detail.
notable: AI assistant prompt for market questions
Live financial news feed with economic event countdowns
caveats: Portfolio and watchlist features require logging in
Page text does not detail the AI analysis methods or accuracy
Free status comes from the directory listing rather than the page itself
